This file carries the license notice for addon-web-links.js — the vendored
@xterm/addon-web-links UMD bundle (see the provenance comment on
VENDOR_WEB_LINKS_JS in ../../src/lib.rs for its exact version and source).
Unlike addon-clipboard.js, which compiles js-base64 in as a webpack module,
this bundle has no bundled third-party code at all: its source map names
only the addon's own two sources plus webpack's bootstrap, and the bundle
contains no `require` calls — so the single MIT text below is the whole of
what its distribution requires. Copied verbatim from the package's own
LICENSE file as published to npm.

Certification digests (see the U6 worker report for the full audit):
- registry tarball @xterm/addon-web-links 0.12.0:
  sha512-4Smom3RPyVp7ZMYOYDoC/9eGJJJqYhnPLGGqJ6wOBfB8VxPViJNSKdgRYb8NpaM6YSelEKbA2SStD7lGyqaobw==
  (matches the registry's published integrity; shasum bc34ae46f4c12012256d451ac2b9be791c0b6bfa)
- retained addon-web-links.js (3100 bytes, byte-identical to the tarball's
  lib/addon-web-links.js):
  sha256:b74864125ef3889753b94e61eb4dabb99b2a27f920f0c9a7bd53cbe6d10f032a

This notice ships inside the distributed bundles, not just beside the
source: WEB_LINKS_LICENSES in ../../src/lib.rs declares this file as an
asset, so the web bundle and the desktop release's embedded UI tree both
carry it (see that declaration for why a source-side text file alone would
prove nothing).
